# Cooling upgrades and bypass systems

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Flush transmission lines, cap them off, and install a cooler with L-brackets and adapters. [t786]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Flush the transmission lines that previously ran fluid through the radiator.
2. [Partial] Cap off the flushed hard lines to seal them.

_Procedure reported by [t786]._

## Specifications

- **Cooler connector type**: 1/2" NPT connectors [t786] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Transmission line adapter size**: 5/16" compression fitting on one end converting to 3/8" barb [t786] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Use small 'L' brackets to mount the cooler in place. [t786]
- Install 90° adapters to bring cooler connections down from 1/2" NPT to 3/8" barbs. [t786]
